FLYFF POINTER RECOVERY TEST
===========================

You do not need Python, pip, PowerShell, or any coding tools.

Install
-------
1. Extract the ZIP Riddims sent you to a normal folder.
2. Double-click FlyffPointerRecoveryTestSetup.exe.
3. Follow the normal Windows installation wizard.
4. The installer places two shortcuts on your desktop:
   - FlyFF Pointer Recovery Test
   - Uninstall FlyFF Pointer Recovery Test

Before running the test
-----------------------
1. Open Spirit Of Madrigal and log into the character you will test with.
2. Go to the farm map and stand at the tower spawn.
3. Heal the character to full HP.
4. Make sure Captain Asterius monsters are loaded nearby.
5. Leave the game open.

Run the test
------------
1. Double-click FlyFF Pointer Recovery Test on the desktop.
2. Enter only your character name. Example: Riddims
3. Enter the max HP shown in the game.
4. Keep the game open while the black test window is running.
5. Stay at the tower spawn during the initial discovery scan.
6. After the window says "Continuous read started", walk around the farm map
   so several monster areas load. Killing monsters is optional.
7. Wait for the completion message. The test runs for about three minutes after
   discovery finishes.

What to send back
-----------------
The test automatically creates ONE ZIP whose name starts with:

SEND_TO_RIDDIMS_

File Explorer opens with that ZIP selected when the test finishes.
Send that one ZIP back to Riddims unchanged.

It is saved under:

Documents\FlyffPointerRecoveryTest

If the test fails, it should still create a return ZIP containing the error log.
Send that ZIP back as well.

Uninstall after sending the ZIP
-------------------------------
1. Send the SEND_TO_RIDDIMS ZIP to Riddims first.
2. Double-click Uninstall FlyFF Pointer Recovery Test on the desktop.
3. Confirm the normal Windows uninstall wizard.

The executable uninstaller removes the installed tester files and the generated
Documents\FlyffPointerRecoveryTest folder. The original downloaded installer
ZIP can then be deleted normally.

Windows security warning
------------------------
This is an unsigned private test program. Windows may display a SmartScreen
warning. Use only the copy sent directly by Riddims. Select More info, then
Run anyway.
